lines.text: Many learners say: Eventually, I will come to your party.
Better: Maybe I will come to your party.
Eventually means in the end. If you are not sure, say maybe.

data.wrong: Eventually, I will come to your party.
data.right: Maybe I will come to your party.
data.why: Eventually means in the end. If you are not sure, say maybe.

quiz.stem: I do not know yet. ___ I will come.
